_about: Probes: realistic sentences where a lexicon word appears in another sense (an agency, a card, a job, a body part, a charity), each paired with the true positive it must not break. Started from an outside finding ("I don't have a social security number" flagged a mother as a senior). Scored with the rest; failures here were fixed by tightening the lexicon, never by editing the case.

cases.text: I'm a mother of three kids aged 2, 5 and 8 and we need food. I don't have a social security number.
cases._why: outside review: SSN sentence flagged a 30-something mother as a senior and flipped two 60+ programs to likely

cases.text: I lost my social security card and need food for my kids
cases._why: a card is not an age

cases.text: The social security office cut my kids' survivor benefits and now we can't buy groceries
My son gets SSDI from Social Security and we're behind on rent
Social Security cut my SSI and I can't pay rent
cases._why: SSI is disability or low income, not age

cases.text: I'm 34 and a senior at the community college and I can't afford food
I retired from the army at 42 and now I'm homeless
cases._why: retired at 42 is not a senior

cases.text: I'm retired and living on Social Security, I need food
Soy jubilada y vivo del seguro social, necesito comida
My Social Security retirement check isn't enough to cover rent
My 70-year-old mother lives with us, I'm 45, and we need food
cases._why: a relative's age is not the person's age

cases.text: The Salvation Army shelter is full tonight and I have nowhere to sleep
I served in a restaurant for ten years and just lost my job, we need food
I worked at the military base cafeteria and got laid off, I need help with rent
cases._why: a civilian job on a base

cases.text: I served in the Army for 6 years and now I'm homeless
I'm a Navy veteran and need a doctor
Serví en el ejército y ahora necesito vivienda
My car was parked on the street and got towed, is that legal?
We've been living on the streets for a week
Mi carro estaba en la calle y se lo llevó la grúa, necesito ayuda legal
Nos dejaron en la calle con los niños
Vivo en la calle desde hace un mes
My kids are grown and moved out, I live alone and need food
I worked as a child care provider and got laid off, I need food
cases._why: a job, not a household member

cases.text: I have two kids and we need food
No tengo hijos, vivo sola y necesito comida
I need a substance abuse treatment program and I don't have insurance
cases._why: substance abuse is treatment, not violence

cases.text: My back hurts me every day and I can't afford a doctor
My husband hurts me when he drinks
My boyfriend is abusive and I need to leave
He hurts me and I'm scared to go home
I hurt myself at work lifting boxes and need a doctor
Sometimes I want to hurt myself
I hurt myself last night on purpose
I don't have a disability, I just lost my job and need food
I'm not pregnant, but I need food for my toddler
I'm in the US on an F-1 student visa and I can't afford food
cases._why: a temporary visa, stated by the speaker

cases.text: I'm currently in the US on the Visa Waiver Program and need a doctor
My friend's visa expired and she needs a lawyer
cases._why: someone else's status is not the speaker's

cases.text: Is he going to get deported? I'm asking for my cousin
I hold US citizenship and need help with rent
I got my green card through my K1 visa and now I need food
cases._why: the green card wins over the visa it came from
